name: 48439 · Grand Blanc, MI
findings: ZIP 48439 (Grand Blanc) has 149 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48439 (Grand Blanc) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48439 (Grand Blanc) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
